note: Each command is a button. Pressing it sends the request to EVERY controller in the selected group. Objects without a 'label' (like this one) are ignored, so they work as comments. Add/remove commands freely.

A command with 'response_field' is a STATUS button: the (dotted) field is read from each controller's JSON reply, aggregated across the group, and shown on the button (all equal -> value; numbers differ -> min-max range; else a distinct list). Polled in the background and refreshed on press.
